summary.zh: 提升本地商家在地图搜索中的排名与口碑
summary.en: Lift local map rankings, listings and review replies for one business

description.zh: 围绕单个本地商家处理 Google Business Profile、地图排名、服务区域页、NAP 信息一致性和评价回复。适合门店、诊所和服务商想被附近客户找到时使用。随附检查与生成脚本，需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Handles one local business end to end: Google Business Profile, map rankings, service-area pages, NAP consistency and review replies. Fits shops, clinics and service providers that want to be found nearby. Bundled scripts need local Python.
